hooks.command: modified_files=$(mktemp) && output_file=$(mktemp --suffix=.md) && { echo "=== Files Modified ==="; git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null || echo "No changes"; } > "$modified_files" && bash "${HOME}/${MDC_REPO_ROOT}/.claude/hooks/run_review.sh" "$modified_files" "$output_file" 2>&1 && bash "${HOME}/${MDC_REPO_ROOT}/.claude/hooks/review_to_memory.sh" "$modified_files" "$output_file"
